HEAD AND NECK SURGERY
Clean procedures include thyroidectomy and lymph node excisions.
- Clean-contaminated procedures include all procedures involving an incision through the oral or pharyngeal mucosa. Clean-contaminated procedures include esophagectomy.
Clean procedures, no prosthesis: No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended.

# If no antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended, select below:

*No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended

# References

- Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 Vol 70 page 195-283
Therapy:
## Clean, prosthesis inserted:

## Preferred:

Cefazolin 2 gm IV over 30 minutes, beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [R]

Post-op doses are not indicated.

## Alternative for patients with beta lactam allergy:

Clindamycin 900 mg IV over 30 minutes, beginning 60 minutes before incision ($$) [H,O]

Post-op doses are not indicated.

## Clean-contaminated procedures including cancer surgery:

## Preferred:

Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision. ($) [R]
Prophylaxis recommendations includes q6h for 3 doses post-op.

Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order after admission.

< OR >
Cefazolin 2gm IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [DI]
Prophylaxis recommendations includes BOTH MEDICATIONS q8h for 2 doses post-op.

Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis orders after admission.

## Alternative for patients with beta lactam allergy:

Clindamycin 900 mg IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision ($$) [H,O]
Prophylaxis recommendation includes q8h for 2 doses post-op. Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order after admission.
**Prophylaxis not indicated for tonsillectomy or functional endoscopic sinus procedures.
